source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch removes unused message-URL interface casts so EWS nsIURI values can reach the same header path. modifyMessageHeaders first checks the displayed part, asks the message service for a header and uses gMessage only when a failed lookup still matches the current message identity. Otherwise it returns. Current code retains this boundary, although its old URL helper was later removed. The initial browser task checks an unknown signature icon with no imported key; the later current fixture imports a key and expects verified. The icon helper is a selector, not independent cryptographic proof. No message or test ran.
title: OpenPGP header updates ask the message service for the header without requiring a message-URL interface
